conditions.evidence: in treating young patients with Wilms tumor
conditions.label: Wilms tumor

output.population: Young patients with Wilms tumor, including children with bilateral Wilms tumor, enrolled in COG trial NCT00945009 (AREN0534)
output.summary: Data from a Children's Oncology Group phase III trial of combination chemotherapy and surgery in young patients with Wilms tumor, including bilateral disease treated with preoperative chemotherapy to preserve renal parenchyma.
